user.title: Welcome to Zählerfreunde
user.description:
This integration connects your Home Assistant instance to the Zählerfreunde platform.

During setup you will:
1. **Select a device category** (e.g. inverter, grid meter, battery).
2. **Optionally pick the Home Assistant device** that belongs to that category (skip to allow any entity).
3. **Map its entities** to the correct sensor roles.
4. **Authorize the connection** by completing a quick login on the Zählerfreunde website.

Click **Submit** to get started.
